items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I had him, I got him his first job with the tuxedo.

ctx.x: Yeah. Now we was all day on East of Sun. We left home about 9 o'clock East of Sun. Monday morning. And it was about 9, 10 o'clock East of Sun at night. And we had one number all day and I thought the number stinks, man. And that's the number made String Bay famous. All over the country. Made people... And I was... Louie would hold that note and I'm on the room some chairs right behind him, man. And he'd walk it. And I'm just walking. Walking right behind him. Walking right behind him. Walking right behind him.…

I was just walking, walking right behind me. And I just played on every chair right behind him, see, and he hold that one note, man. Paul, I just pushed him, just play it, see. And that was a great number. And I thought it was crazy, man, I hated the thing. I was staying on it all day. You know how you can rehearse a number all day, you get a... But then everybody started to buy string basses. And everybody had, every one of them kids that go to the house the first day in this play, and try to play, I said, man,…
